domainConclusions.statement: Current media ingest and storage cannot support frame-accurate mixed-rate, VFR, timecode, colour-managed or conform workflows because canonical source identity is absent.
Ducking, SFX, generated music and transition-SFX workflows combine multiple owners or writes; only beat-sync currently reaches one bounded project CAS.
The conditioned-byte analyzer is evidence-based while five-track analysis passes a URL to a decoded-buffer API and can silently substitute 120 BPM.
Atomic form, rights and acoustic gates are real, but catalog search/materialization and labelling evidence do not certify contextual selection or audible timeline quality.
The Remotion sound consumer applies timing, fades and ducking, but no generalized output proof verifies audibility, speech intelligibility, clipping, loudness or channel delivery.
